title: Execution.
bodyText: The governor shall execute the compact on behalf of this State, and perform any other acts which may be deemed requisite to its formal adoption.
bodyHtml: §311-5  Execution.  The governor shall execute the compact on behalf of this State, and perform any other acts which may be deemed requisite to its formal adoption. [L 1966, c 32, §6; HRS §311-5]
